note: Draft 1: hard pass (twenty ids, the b-lines as latin.readVerses keys them). Soft flags accepted: length +3 to +5 in 26:1b, 26:2 (both colons), 26:3, 26:4, 26:6, 26:6b second colon, 26:12, 26:14 (the copulas supplied in the titles of 26:1–1b, 'os malfeitores', 'entoarei um salmo' for 'psalmum dicam' (17:50's words), 'porta-te varonilmente'); −4/−5 in 26:5, 26:6b first colon, 26:9b (the Latin's long words). Rhymes: 26:1 / 26:1b 'temerei / tremerei' — the Latin's own (timébo / trepidábo), two questions built alike; 26:5 'tenda … tenda' — the Latin repeats tabernáculum; both kept. 26:13 now ends on 'vivos' (paroxytone).
